name: com.setnet.geodata
description: Unity tool that bakes a portable SetNet.GeoData file (.geo) from a scene's NavMesh or colliders — including multi-storey LAYERED grids (floors/bridges without a nav-mesh) and SECTORED worlds (tiles + a .geomap manifest). Menu: SetNet > Bake GeoData. Includes a Scene-view debug visualizer (GeoDataGizmo). Writes an engine-independent binary blob a headless SetNet server loads via GeoDataFile.LoadFromFile / GeoDataManifest.Load — no runtime engine dependency, no SetNet assembly needed.
